https://kaedeko.fanbox.cc/

Continuation of https://e-hentai.org/g/3330156/47d8b21329/
Kaedeko's password game has made things a bit more complicated. More reason to archive what I do have (which is complete for now).
Thanks goes out to the guy who imported stuff in Kemono of course, but also to the anons who uploaded the passworded difference sets I didn't manage to grab in time myself (which was more often than not) and continue to do so with Kemono seemingly not getting any imports anymore.
I do not have a subscription but will do my best to keep this updated as things fall into my hands.

If anyone cares: As far as original filenames for the externally downloaded differences go, the 2025-05-16 post files were named "20250303-差分-b"/"20250303-差分-c" for example, referencing the pixiv post date of the original illustration.
This pattern seems to have been consistently used and I confirmed it for all the files currently in the gallery.

Update 2025-08-01:
Added all that was posted since last time. Gallery is still complete.
Big thanks to the anon who kept posting new sets since my own methods weren't fruitful as of late (unsynced post and fancard imports make the password game pretty effective). Seeing as he's not that happy with the recent posts he might not stay around though, unfortunately.

Sasaki Kei's difference set of July did not get a mystery liquid version, so there's only that one image.

Update 2025-09-04:
So far, still complete. However, the last Kemono import did not include 2k yen tier posts. For August this is fine, as the PSDs or extra thumbnails aren't part of what I include in this gallery anyhow.
But it does seem like the guy who imported his keys on Kemono pulled out and the anon who was nice enough to share the difference sets was also considering doing that. So any further updates on the interesting stuff are kind of uncertain right now.

Update 2025-09-27:
Kemono is back at importing 2k yen posts, helpful anons remain and perhaps there are even multiple now.
Kaedeko himself has stopped using passwords, but is quick to invalidate any download links still. In theory one less thing to worry about, but so far Kemono hasn't been importing any revisions for me to grab at the right time either.
Not that it really matters as I got everything elsewhere. So complete and updates will likely continue.

I'm grouping difference sets together btw, so September's extra Kanna difference is sorted with the August ones.
Other posts are sorted by post ID which sometimes differ from publication order as he seems to prepare some posts way in advance.

Update 2025-10-28:
Everything's in order, not much of note to say this time. There was only one 2k yen post this month, but one could argue he drew 3 bare chests this time to even it out or something.

The 2025-10-27 pixiv post was uploaded after the monthly wrap-up fanbox post, so a large or sketch variant of it is not included yet. An interesting bit on that pixiv post is that its name is "お約束" instead of just "ガキ巨乳". It also didn't advance the numbering. The special differences on the fanbox usually came with a proper title there and those are used whenever he's advertising the fanbox on pixiv, but otherwise this hadn't happened before.
Not that I know if that means anything, but staring at his stuff and how he posts things made me notice posting patterns, fixed times, posts prepared ahead & out of order, and such. It's odd for him to deviate from the usual pattern here. Though the drawing itself is nothing exceptional.

Update 2025-12-01:
Only one image of note this month again. More of that one supposedly next time. Hopefully more than the usual or differences for another image as well... but with this guy you never know.
The random ramblings from last time seem to have meant nothing. Maybe just not numbered because it's the cover for the new book.

Update 2025-12-31:
As much as I had already left a somewhat doomy edit in a comment below, anon came back with gifts just in time.
Kemono is still not updated, so 500 yen posts for this month are missing. I'm not gonna ask anon for those. I value not being too demanding over completeness here. That's the stuff that would be easily accessible once Kemono does update after all and I'm just grateful that guy's around in the first place.
As noted before, I group difference sets together. Two of this month's images are grouped with last month's.

Update 2026-01-01:
Shit just keeps coming in within hours after I decide to go about without it, huh? Kemono imported all of the sudden, so December posts are complete now. Decided to not wait a month for this one.

Update 2026-02-22:
I was hesitant to doompost again just in case, but it wasn't looking that well.
There was at least one anon claiming they he had unsubscribed and Kemono imports stopping since then gave me little doubt about this being from our guy.
Despite that, he now returned and graced us with more stuff. Apparently his old account got banned and was connected to Kemono, so probably no more imports there. As much as I enjoy having the full res images... they're not as important to have, so this is more than fair.

Update 2026-02-24:
January 500-yen tier images have turned up, so there you go. Complete again, for now.
Thanks to anon... anons? I don't know how many are or aren't out there at this point but I'm glad things do crop up still. As noted before, this gallery is sorted by post IDs, of which the January end post has the highest right now, so those two images are last.

Update 2026-02-27:
February 500-yen tier added. Not much else to say but I always leave an update note so uh... thanks to anon.

Update 2026-03-02:
There was an oopsie with the previous update not being the full-size images. Correct ones are there now. Probably will slow down with updates a bit now too.

Update 2026-04-02:
Monthly update time. 500-yen images are missing, but I'll add them once they pop up anywhere. Probably just a matter of time.

Update 2026-04-30:
A bit of a weak month imo, but here's the stuff. Including what was missing last time.
Not sure about the figurine post. I don't have it, but for now I don't consider photo stuff as strictly part of the gallery. So I dare to say it is complete again as of now.
The usual thanks go out. Doubly so for filling in the gaps.

Update 2026-05-30:
May saw no new drawings on pixiv. He's kind of about run out of things to make differences of (ママ巨乳⑧⑨ would still be a prime target I expected to have been done already by this point). Maybe June is going to be more interesting?
Obviously we did get the pool differences. And that's it. No full res variants or PSDs as there wasn't anything new to give out.
In case you haven't been following Kaedeko's Twitter, a Kanna figurine with cast-off option is going to come out. Classic ガキ巨乳⑤③ in 3D. Curiously, the figurine's photo gallery might be the first time he lets you see her nipples for free. Bandaid's still there though, so don't get too excited.

As always, I'm also just freeloading here. Thanks go out to anon for providing the goods.

Update 2026-06-28:
It's been a little over a year since I started being the guy to put Kanna on the Panda. I am abusing this space as some sort of blog since I don't really have any other space for specific oppai loli artist ramblings...
It's definitely been a unique ride of sorts with random hurdles to acquire the goods (throwing money at it would be too easy) and Kemono dying, but even that has mellowed out and it's been mostly smooth sailing there.

With that being said, I don't like the direction Kaedeko appears to be heading. Monthly content is getting less and less and kinda stagnating (with the odd standout every 6 months I guess).
And well, that new art style he seems to be sticking with now is really not to my taste. Putting a more mature look on an oppai loli character... like what's the point? If this keeps up I'll probably lose interest in his stuff altogether even if he were to go more intense with Kanna.
At the same time, keeping this gallery updated isn't a big deal so I'll keep doing that as long as I keep getting the images from somewhere.

You may notice that the end of June 500 yen post is missing. I don't have it yet (probably next month), but within the date range of the gallery title it's technically still complete. In the meantime, enjoy the single image he managed to give his supporters for 2k yen a month.
Thanks to anons for providing and continuing so for over a year. I'm just some dude re-uploading stuff.

Update 2026-07-28:
Another month over, probably. There's still a 5th Friday for July, but the typically end of month 500 yen post was already posted on the 4th one.
Somebody imported their key into Pawchive and external download links were still working, even if I had no need for them. Convenient to grab the 500 yen posts, however. Let's see how long that lasts.

An interesting detail with having updated older posts is that he seems to have added every 2k yen image from April 2026 and before to the actual posts at some point. Maybe he knows there's no point but newer posts still have MEGA links.
With that having happened, I've replaced the previously external images with the fanbox post ones. This only affects the names and some ordering in the gallery. The files themselves are identical. Also added the figurine photos while at it.
Other technically-not-yet missing posts from last month are of course also there, along with the stuff from this month. Gallery is complete.

Thanks go out to Pawchive anon this time. Maybe it's even the same as one of the others, but I wouldn't know.

Update 2026-09-03:
Fairly eventful month. Kind of. In terms of content there's next to nothing, but things might be happening in September instead. New 3k yen tier with presumably more intense stuff coming exists starting now. 2k yen tier will receive the same contents a month later. Whether this means there'll be additional content or 2k yen tier will be basically left blank for a month... dude's not been throwing out much, but who knows.
Also, upper tiers are now gated behind Fanbox Discord integration. It shouldn't impact things showing up regardless, but Pawchive updates for that stuff are not an option then I guess. Whether some anon shows up to throw even more money at him is also up in the air still, so maybe expect a month of delays then.
I'm just here to collect stuff... and hope that in all of this mess there's gonna be some interesting posts at least. Thanks go out to Pawchive anon again.

As a random tidbit, this month's difference image as I initially shared the link to in the comments had some exif chunk that the site choked on and made it reject the file when trying to upload it. The image available in the currently still working MEGA link doesn't have it. The data itself there were only some dates, nothing of note. Pixel data between both files was identical, but still odd this happened.
